messages.en:
{07 0b 00}You wanna know what I'm
doing with this {ff 00 00 07}shovel{ff 00 00 00}?{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}I'm looking for fossils!
{07 14 00}Digging works all kinds of
muscle groups,{01 00 00 05 00} so it's like
a workout, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Tahad teada, mida ma
selle {ff 00 00 07}labidaga{ff 00 00 00} teen?{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}Ma otsin fossiile!
{07 14 00}Kaevamine paneb tööle
igasugused lihased,{01 00 00 05 00} nii et
see on trenn, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Help me look, wouldja?

{07 00 00}For what?! Are you crazy?!{01 00 00 0a 00}
For fossils, man! {01 00 00 05 00}Fossils!

{07 14 00}From now on, I want you to
call me {ff 00 00 06}{04 01 00}, the
Fossil Hunter{ff 00 00 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Aita mul otsida, eks?

{07 00 00}Mida?! Kas sa oled hull?!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Fossiile, mees! {01 00 00 05 00}Fossiile!

{07 14 00}Nüüdsest tahan, et sa
kutsuksid mind {ff 00 00 06}{04 01 00},
fossiilikütiks{ff 00 00 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 06}Blathers{ff 00 00 00} told me{01 00 00 05 00} fossils
are actually the remains of
dinosaurs...
{07 14 00}Yeah, dinosaurs that were
buried thousands of years
ago, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}I wonder, if I got buried
in this place, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}would I
become a fossil, too?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 06}Blathers{ff 00 00 00} ütles mulle,{01 00 00 05 00} et
fossiilid on tegelikult
dinosauruste jäänused...
{07 14 00}Jah, dinosaurused, kes
maeti tuhandeid aastaid
tagasi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Huvitav, kas ma muutuksin
ka fossiiliks, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}kui mind
siia maha maetaks?

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I can't tell where fossils
are buried{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Seriously,
I have no clue, {04 02 00}.
{07 06 00}There oughta be a way to
tell{01 00 00 05 00} if nothing is there!{01 00 00 05 00}
This stinks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma ei oska öelda, kuhu
fossiilid on{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Ausalt,
mul pole aimugi, {04 02 00}.
{07 06 00}Peaks olema mingi viis,
kuidas teada,{01 00 00 05 00} kui tühi!{01 00 00 05 00}
See on nõme, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}So{01 00 00 05 00} are you saying that
fossils are actually just
rocks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}I thought{01 00 00 05 00} that if you
poured hot water on them,
they'd come back to life!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Nii et{01 00 00 05 00} sa ütled, et
fossiilid on tegelikult
lihtsalt kivid, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}Ma arvasin,{01 00 00 05 00} et kui neile
kuuma vett peale valada,
ärkavad nad ellu!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Have you ever looked at a
dinosaur fossil and
thought...
{07 15 00}"Y'know, I should get more
calcium in my diet"?{01 00 00 14 00} {07 0b 00}Well,
have ya?
.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}Look, I'm not{01 00 00 05 00} saying you
HAVE to or anything. {01 00 00 05 00}I'm
just asking, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kas sa oled kunagi
vaadanud dinosauruse
fossiili ja mõelnud...
{07 15 00}„Tead, ma peaksin rohkem
kaltsiumi sööma”?{01 00 00 14 00} {07 0b 00}Noh,
kas oled?
.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}Kuule, ma ei ütle,{01 00 00 05 00} et sa
PEAD või midagi. {01 00 00 05 00}Ma lihtsalt
küsin, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I'm training and fossil
hunting at the same time
today!
{07 16 00}...But for some reason,{01 00 00 05 00} I'm
not finding anything{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}I know, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}You can help me look for
fossils! {01 00 00 05 00}YEAH! {01 00 00 05 00}Let's ROCK!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma treenin ja jahin
fossiile täna samal
ajal!
{07 16 00}...Aga millegipärast{01 00 00 05 00} ma
ei leia midagi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}Ma tean, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}Sa saad mind fossiilide
otsimisel aidata!{01 00 00 05 00} JAH!{01 00 00 05 00} ROKI!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Fossils{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Must...{01 00 00 05 00}find...{01 00 00 05 00}them.
{07 06 00}I haven't found a single one
and it's almost nightfall!
{07 00 00}It's so dark that I can't
see a thing{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 15 00}Aw, man!{01 00 00 0f 00} Forget fossils!{01 00 00 05 00}
I wanna just do sit-ups
until my head pops!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Fossiil{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Pean{01 00 00 05 00}...{01 00 00 05 00}leidma.
{07 06 00}Ma pole ühtegi leidnud ja
peagi on öö käes!
{07 00 00}On nii pime, et ma ei näe
mitte midagi{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 15 00}Oh mees!{01 00 00 0f 00} Unusta fossiilid!{01 00 00 05 00}
Ma tahan lihtsalt teha
kõhulihaseid, kuni lõhken!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Well,{01 00 00 05 00} whether I find some
or not...

{07 14 00}Fossil-hunting{01 00 00 0f 00} is just
something we men have
to do, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Noh,{01 00 00 05 00} leian ma neid või
mitte...

{07 14 00}Fossiilijaht{01 00 00 0f 00} on lihtsalt
midagi, mida meie, mehed,
teha peame, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
